newsitem.title: CANADA: TrizecHahn files for 12.5 mln share issue.
newsitem.headline: TrizecHahn files for 12.5 mln share issue.

text.p: TrizecHahn Corp said on Monday it filed a preliminary short-form prospectus in Canada and the United States for an offering of 12.5 million additional subordinate voting shares.

TrizecHahn said the offering would further supplement the commpany's capital in light of numberous investment initiatives, as well as increase TrizecHahn's visibility and institutional ownership, particularly in the U.S.

Proceeds of the offering will be used for general corporate purposes and to repay indebtedness including redeeming, in accordance with its terms, a portion of the 10.875 percent senior notes due October 2005 of Trizec Finance Ltd.
